name: Introduction to Anti-Caste Thought and Literature
description: The course will focus on the following topics: Buddhist critiques of caste; Bhakti movement; anti-Brahmanism; anti-caste movements and new discourses (Jotirao Phule, Iyothee Thass, Periyar, Ambedkar); literary articulations of about and against caste and casteism (Dalit literature: autobiography, poetry); role of anti-racism in anti-caste thought; debates on sociology and historiography of caste; anti-caste expressive cultures.
